name: Museum der Wahrnehmung
kurzbeschreibung: 007 ELEMENTS atop the 3,048-metre Gaislachkogl in Sölden is a cinematic James Bond installation embedded into the dramatic Ötztal summit.
beschreibung:
Overview

007 ELEMENTS is a world-class cinematic installation perched atop the 3,048-metre summit of Gaislachkogl above Sölden. Designed by renowned Tyrolean architect Johann Obermoser, the striking underground concrete structure is carved directly into the alpine permafrost, seamlessly merging cutting-edge contemporary design with the raw alpine grandeur of the Ötztal Alps. As an authentic filming location for director Sam Mendes' James Bond blockbuster Spectre starring Daniel Craig, the exhibition plunges guests into the thrilling universe of 007. Across nine dynamic galleries, the installation explores the signature elements of the franchise, from iconic musical scores and technical gadgets to original movie props and stunt planes.

Route & Requirements

Visitors reach the exhibition effortlessly via the state-of-the-art Gaislachkogl cable car sections I and II from Sölden. Given the high-altitude environment above 3,000 metres, visitors should anticipate thinner air and consistently cold interior temperatures. To preserve the delicate permafrost bedrock, the galleries are unheated; warm mountain clothing and sturdy footwear are strongly recommended even in midsummer. The indoor tour is fully step-free and accessible, guiding visitors along sleek ramps to panoramic glass balconies showcasing sweeping views of glaciated peaks.

Visiting & Getting There

Sölden is easily accessed by car along the B186 Ötztal valley road or by regular regional buses departing from Ötztal railway station. The Gaislachkogl valley station features a large covered car park free of charge for cable car passengers. 007 ELEMENTS is open throughout both the summer and winter cable car operating seasons. Because admission is managed via timed entry slots, booking combined lift and museum tickets online in advance is highly recommended.

Tips

Combine your mission with fine dining at the adjacent ice Q gourmet restaurant, which starred as the futuristic Hoffler Clinic in Spectre, offering gourmet cuisine accompanied by 360-degree alpine panoramas. During winter, skiers can integrate the experience directly into their day on the slopes. The contrast between brutalist concrete architecture and pristine glacial wilderness provides world-class photography opportunities.
